description: Implementation of the NoteListWidget class managing a list of notes, including initialization, adding, removing, trashing, restoring, sorting, and searching notes within a Qt application.

classes.name: NoteListWidget
classes.description: A Qt widget class managing a list of notes, supporting operations like add, remove, trash, restore, sort, and search.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the widget by loading note directories and creating note models.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a new note item to the list widget based on a NoteModel.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Creates a new NoteModel with a category and updates the UI and configuration accordingly.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves a QListWidgetItem by note UUID.

methods.name: getNoteModel
methods.description: Retrieves the NoteModel associated with a given UUID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a note by UUID, deleting its directory and updating the UI.

methods.name: trash
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted and updates the UI.

methods.name: trash
methods.description: Marks a given NoteModel as deleted and updates the UI.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a deleted note by UUID.

methods.name: setListWidget
methods.description: Filters and displays notes based on current configuration.

methods.name: setItemSelected
methods.description: Selects and highlights a note item based on configuration.

methods.name: noteModelChanged
methods.description: Updates the display when a note model changes.

methods.name: getNoteModelList
methods.description: Returns a list of all NoteModels in the widget.

methods.name: getListWidgetItemList
methods.description: Filters and returns list widget items based on group type and name.

methods.name: getNoteModelList
methods.description: Returns NoteModels filtered by a GroupModel.

methods.name: getNoteModelList
methods.description: Returns NoteModels filtered by group type and name.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Placeholder for modifying notes (not implemented).

methods.name: search
methods.description: Filters notes based on search text.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts notes based on configured basis and order.

methods.name: getNoteModel
methods.description: Retrieves the NoteModel from a QListWidgetItem.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a note with given UUID exists.

methods.name: onActionTriggered
methods.description: Handles action trigger events, currently triggers sorting.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the widget.
